Subject: Westrow Outfitters Submission - Referral Questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the Westrow Outfitters submission. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need to move forward.

However, the five-year loss history exceeds $250K, which requires management review before I can provide a quote. To help present this to our senior underwriter, could you please provide:

- Details on what corrective actions have been taken to address the losses
- Any risk improvements or safety measures implemented since the loss activity
- Context around the claims (nature, cause, preventable vs. non-preventable)

If this doesn't work out on our end, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty surplus lines market that focuses on higher-hazard outdoor retail risks.

I'll circle back once I hear from you.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
